title: The Third Confession Anew
author: Jude Thackeray
blurb: Tamsin Villalobos, a night-shift dispatcher for a taxi company, has spent twelve years keeping the town's secrets filed and alphabetized. But when a client pays in advance to prove a murder hasn't happened — yet, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, he must find the witness everyone swears is dead before the statute expires.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
